title: Reverse Survivors: survivor status effects
objective: Give the survivor three debuff channels - slow (movement), suppress (fire rate) and bleed (regen block) - so ranged and fast units have a lever beyond raw damage. The system must be cross-cutting yet contribute zero branches, so the 100% coverage gate stays affordable.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run check` passes standalone: tsc --noEmit clean, eslint --max-warnings 0 clean, vitest at 100% statements/branches/functions/lines.
The status module itself adds zero branches, verified against the v8 branch count (117 -> 119 accounted for solely by the draw halo gate and the snapshot chip filter).
Re-applying a status refreshes rather than stacks, so total lockdown is capped at one duration regardless of horde size.
An enemy that inflicts nothing leaves all three timers at exactly 0.
Survivor-fired projectiles can never debuff the survivor.
out_of_scope: Director powers and difficulty tiers, which ship as separate commits.
Aura or ranged-application debuffs: all three require contact by design, so a cleanly kiting survivor takes none.
verifier: npm run check (typecheck + eslint --max-warnings 0 + vitest --coverage at 100%), plus targeted sim.test.ts assertions comparing slowed movement against an unslowed control run
